floors.clue: High renown or honour won by notable achievements.
Complete trust or confidence in someone or something.
Great courage in the face of danger, especially in battle.
High respect, esteem, or adherence to what is right.
A great victory, achievement, or state of celebration.
The ability to do something that frightens one; bravery.
Valued objects and qualities such as historic buildings that have been passed down.
The act of taking control of a country or group of people by military force.
Deep respect for someone or something, often held with awe.
The male head of a family, tribe, or venerable institution.
